<transformation>
The input is treated as a tile map. The output is NxM times larger than the input (where the input is N rows x M cols). Each input cell at (BR, BC) with a non-zero value causes a copy of the full input to be placed in the corresponding NxM block of the output (at rows BR*N .. BR*N+N-1, cols BC*M .. BC*M+M-1). Each input cell with value 0 produces an all-zero block at that position.
</transformation>

<asp>
% Count distinct row/col indices — equals grid dimensions for 0-indexed inputs
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R, _, _)}.
n_cols(N) :- N = #count{C : input(_, C, _)}.

% Output is NR*NR rows and NC*NC cols (input tiled by itself)
output_cell(R, C) :-
    input(BR, BC, _), input(DR, DC, _),
    n_rows(NR), n_cols(NC),
    R = BR*NR + DR, C = BC*NC + DC.

1 { output(R, C, Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R, C).

% Non-zero block: the sub-cell must equal the input value at the relative position
:- input(BR, BC, V), V != 0,
   input(DR, DC, TileColor),
   n_rows(NR), n_cols(NC),
   R = BR*NR + DR, C = BC*NC + DC,
   output(R, C, ActualColor), ActualColor != TileColor.

% Zero block: every sub-cell must be 0
:- input(BR, BC, 0),
   input(DR, DC, _),
   n_rows(NR), n_cols(NC),
   R = BR*NR + DR, C = BC*NC + DC,
   output(R, C, ActualColor), ActualColor != 0.
</asp>

<transformation>
The output is the same size as the input. Color-3 cells are unchanged. Non-3 cells (value 0) that are enclosed by color-3 walls — i.e., cannot reach the grid boundary via 4-connected movement through non-3 cells — are filled with color 4. All other non-3 cells remain 0.

<asp>
% Output has the same dimensions as the input
output_cell(R, C) :- input(R, C, _).
1 { output(R, C, Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R, C).

% Grid boundary coordinates
min_row(R) :- R = #min{Row : input(Row, _, _)}.
max_row(R) :- R = #max{Row : input(Row, _, _)}.
min_col(C) :- C = #min{Col : input(_, Col, _)}.
max_col(C) :- C = #max{Col : input(_, Col, _)}.

% 4-connected adjacency offsets
delta(0,1). delta(0,-1). delta(1,0). delta(-1,0).

% Non-3 cells on the grid boundary are reachable from outside
outside(R, C) :- input(R, C, V), V != 3, min_row(Rmin), R = Rmin.
outside(R, C) :- input(R, C, V), V != 3, max_row(Rmax), R = Rmax.
outside(R, C) :- input(R, C, V), V != 3, min_col(Cmin), C = Cmin.
outside(R, C) :- input(R, C, V), V != 3, max_col(Cmax), C = Cmax.

% Flood-fill outward through non-3 cells
outside(R2, C2) :-
    outside(R1, C1), delta(DR, DC),
    R2 = R1+DR, C2 = C1+DC,
    input(R2, C2, V), V != 3.

% Color-3 cells stay 3
:- input(R, C, 3), output(R, C, Color), Color != 3.

% Outside non-3 cells stay 0
:- outside(R, C), output(R, C, Color), Color != 0.

% Interior non-3 cells (enclosed by 3s, not reachable from boundary) become 4
:- input(R, C, 0), not outside(R, C), output(R, C, Color), Color != 4.
</asp>

% -------------------------------------------------
% Colour domain (optional – injected automatically)
color(0..9).

% -------------------------------------------------
% Non‑zero rows and columns (those that contain at least one non‑zero cell)
non_zero_row(R) :- input(R,_,V), V != 0.
non_zero_col(C) :- input(_,C,V), V != 0.

% -------------------------------------------------
% Bounding box of the non‑zero region
min_row(Rmin) :- non_zero_row(Rmin), #min{R : non_zero_row(R)} = Rmin.
max_row(Rmax) :- non_zero_row(Rmax), #max{R : non_zero_row(R)} = Rmax.
min_col(Cmin) :- non_zero_col(Cmin), #min{C : non_zero_col(C)} = Cmin.
max_col(Cmax) :- non_zero_col(Cmax), #max{C : non_zero_col(C)} = Cmax.

% -------------------------------------------------
% Border cells that are non‑zero (they lie on the rectangle border)
border_nonzero(R,C,V) :- input(R,C,V), V != 0,
    (R = min_row; R = max_row; C = min_col; C = max_col).

% -------------------------------------------------
% Wall colour – colour of the border non‑zero cells (must be uniform)
wall_colour(Wc) :- border_nonzero(R,C,V), Wc = V.

% -------------------------------------------------
% Interior cells (strictly inside the rectangle)
interior(R,C) :- R > min_row, R < max_row, C > min_col, C < max_col.

% -------------------------------------------------
% Interior non‑zero colours (used for filler colour)
interior_nonzero_colour(I) :- interior(R,C), input(R,C,V),
    V != 0, V != Wc, I = V.

% -------------------------------------------------
% Candidate colours for the filler colour
candidate(F) :- color(F), F != 0, F != Wc, not interior_nonzero_colour(F).

% -------------------------------------------------
% Filler colour – smallest colour not used by interior non‑zero cells
filler(F) :- candidate(F), F = #min{C : candidate(C)}.

% -------------------------------------------------
% Dimensions of the output rectangle
n_rows(Nr) :- max_row(Rmax), min_row(Rmin), Nr = Rmax - Rmin + 1.
n_cols(Nc) :- max_col(Cmax), min_col(Cmin), Nc = Cmax - Cmin + 1.

% -------------------------------------------------
% Each output cell corresponds to exactly one input cell
rect_cell(Rout,Cout) :-
    input(R,C,_),
    R = min_row + Rout,
    C = min_col + Cout,
    Rout >= 0, Cout >= 0,
    R <= max_row, C <= max_col.

% -------------------------------------------------
% Border cells (any side of the rectangle)
border_cell(Rout,Cout) :-
    rect_cell(Rout,Cout),
    input(R,C,_),
    R = min_row + Rout,
    C = min_col + Cout,
    R = min_row.
border_cell(Rout,Cout) :-
    rect_cell(Rout,Cout),
    input(R,C,_),
    R = min_row + Rout,
    C = min_col + Cout,
    R = max_row.
border_cell(Rout,Cout) :-
    rect_cell(Rout,Cout),
    input(R,C,_),
    R = min_row + Rout,
    C = min_col + Cout,
    C = min_col.
border_cell(Rout,Cout) :-
    rect_cell(Rout,Cout),
    input(R,C,_),
    R = min_row + Rout,
    C = min_col + Cout,
    C = max_col.

% -------------------------------------------------
% Output colour definitions
output(Rout,Cout,Wc) :-
    rect_cell(Rout,Cout),
    border_cell(Rout,Cout),
    input(R,C,Wc),
    R = min_row + Rout,
    C = min_col + Cout.

    rect_cell(Rout,Cout),
    border_cell(Rout,Cout),
    input(R,C,Vsrc),
    Vsrc != Wc,
    R = min_row + Rout,
    C = min_col + Cout.

interior_cell(Rout,Cout) :- rect_cell(Rout,Cout), not border_cell(Rout,Cout).

    interior_cell(Rout,Cout),
    input(R,C,Vsrc),
    Vsrc != 0,
    R = min_row + Rout,
    C = min_col + Cout.

    interior_cell(Rout,Cout),
    input(R,C,0),
    R = min_row + Rout,
    C = min_col + Cout,
    filler(F).

1 { filler(F) : color(F) } 1 :- filler(F).

% -------------------------------------------------
%  The input grid may contain many rows and columns.

non_zero_col(C) :- input(_,C,V), V != 0.

max_row(R)   :- non_zero_row(R), #max{R : non_zero_row(R)} = R.
min_col(C)   :- non_zero_col(C), #min{C : non_zero_col(C)} = C.
max_col(C)   :- non_zero_col(C), #max{C : non_zero_col(C)} = C.

% ----- we treat colour 4 as the wall colour (the only non‑zero colour on the border)
wall_colour(4).

% ----- 4‑connectivity ------------------------------------------------
delta(1,0). delta(-1,0). delta(0,1). delta(0,-1).

% ----- border cells that are *outside* (they are on the edge and not colour 4)
outside(R,C) :- input(R,C,V), V != 4, R = min_row.
outside(R,C) :- input(R,C,V), V != 4, R = max_row.
outside(R,C) :- input(R,C,V), V != 4, C = min_col.
outside(R,C) :- input(R,C,V), V != 4, C = max_col.

% ----- flood‑fill – cells reachable from the border without touching a wall
outside(R2,C2) :-
    outside(R1,C1),
    delta(DR,DC),
    R2 = R1 + DR,
    C2 = C1 + DC,
    R2 >= min_row, R2 <= max_row,
    C2 >= min_col, C2 <= max_col,
    input(R2,C2,V), V != 4.

    BC >= min_col, BC <= max_col.

    output_position(R,C),

    C = BC - min_col,

non_zero_col(C) :- input(_,C,V), V != 0.

% Input facts are injected automatically.

% Colors are 0..9
color(0..9).  % optional

% Define predicate for non-zero rows and columns
non_zero_row(R) :- input(R,_,V), V != 0.
non_zero_col(C) :- input(_,C,V), V != 0.

% Bounding box of the non-zero region
min_row(NR) :- #min{R : non_zero_row(R)} = R.
max_row(PR) :- #max{R : non_zero_row(R)} = R.
min_col(NC) :- #min{C : non_zero_col(C)} = C.
max_col(PC) :- #max{C : non_zero_col(C)} = C.

% Wall colour – colour at the top‑left corner (NR,NC)
wall_colour(Wc) :- input(NR, NC, V), V != 0, V = Wc.

% All border cells that contain a non‑zero must be the wall colour
border_cell(R,C) :- R = min_row.
border_cell(R,C) :- R = max_row.
border_cell(R,C) :- C = min_col.
border_cell(R,C) :- C = max_col.

:- border_cell(R,C), input(R,C,V), V != 0, V != Wc :- false.

% Adjacent offsets for flood fill
delta(1,0). delta(-1,0). delta(0,1). delta(0,-1).

% Flood‑fill from border cells that are not the wall colour
outside(R,C) :- border_cell(R,C), input(R,C,V), V != Wc.
outside(R2,C2) :- outside(R1,C1), delta(DR,DC), R2 = R1+DR, C2 = C1+DC,
                R2 >= min_row, R2 <= max_row, C2 >= min_col, C2 <= max_col,
                input(R2,C2,V), V != Wc.

% Cells of the rectangle that need an output fact
output_cell(R_out,C_out) :-
    R = min_row + R_out - 1,
    C = min_col + C_out - 1,
    input(R,C,V).

% Cells of the output that lie on the border (in terms of input coordinates)
border_output(R_out,C_out) :- output_cell(R_out,C_out),
    (R = min_row ; R = max_row ; C = min_col ; C = max_col).

% Colour assignment
% 1. wall cells (border cells that are non‑zero and have wall colour)
output(R_out,C_out,Wc) :- output_cell(R_out,C_out),
    border_output(R_out,C_out),
    input(R,C,V),
    V = Wc.

% 2. interior non‑zero cells (keep their colour)
output(R_out,C_out,Vsrc) :- output_cell(R_out,C_out),
    input(R,C,Vsrc),
    Vsrc != 0,
    Vsrc != Wc,
    not border_output(R_out,C_out).

% 3. zero cells that are reachable from the border (stay 0)
output(R_out,C_out,0) :- output_cell(R_out,C_out),
    input(R,C,0),
    is_outside(R,C).

% 4. zero cells that are not reachable (become filler colour 1)
output(R_out,C_out,1) :- output_cell(R_out,C_out),
    input(R,C,0),
    not is_outside(R,C).

% Helper predicate for reachable cells
is_outside(R,C) :- outside(R,C).

% Cells that belong to the output rectangle
rect_cell(R_out,C_out) :- output_cell(R_out,C_out).

% Exactly one colour per cell
1 { output(R_out,C_out,Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- rect_cell(R_out,C_out).

% -------------------------------------------------
% End of program

% Define colors domain
color(0..9).

% Non-zero rows and columns
non_zero_row(R) :- input(R,_,V), V != 0.
non_zero_col(C) :- input(_,C,V), V != 0.

% Bounding rectangle of non-zero cells
min_row(Rmin) :- non_zero_row(Rmin), #min{R : non_zero_row(R)} = Rmin.
max_row(Rmax) :- non_zero_row(Rmax), #max{R : non_zero_row(R)} = Rmax.
min_col(Cmin) :- non_zero_col(Cmin), #min{C : non_zero_col(C)} = Cmin.

% Uniformity
:- border_nonzero(R1,C1,V1), border_nonzero(R2,C2,V2),
    V1 != 0, V2 != 0, V1 != V2 :- false.

% Interior cells
interior(R,C) :- R > min_row, R < max_row, C > min_col, C < max_col.

% Filler colour: smallest colour not used in interior_nonzero_colour and not wall, not zero
filler(F) :-
    color(F),
    F != 0,
    F != Wc,

% -------------------------------------------------
% Output colour definitions
output(Rout,Cout,Wc) :-
    rect_cell(Rout,Cout),
    border_cell(Rout,Cout),
    input(R,C,Wc),
    R = min_row + Rout,
    C = min_col + Cout.

output(Rout,Cout,0) :-
    rect_cell(Rout,Cout),
    border_cell(Rout,Cout),
    input(R,C,Vsrc),
    Vsrc != Wc,
    R = min_row + Rout,
    C = min_col + Cout.

interior_cell(Rout,Cout) :- rect_cell(Rout,Cout), not border_cell(Rout,Cout).

output(Rout,Cout,Vsrc) :-
    interior_cell(Rout,Cout),
    input(R,C,Vsrc),
    Vsrc != 0,
    R = min_row + Rout,
    C = min_col + Cout.

output(Rout,Cout,F) :-
    interior_cell(Rout,Cout),
    input(R,C,0),
    R = min_row + Rout,
    C = min_col + Cout,
    filler(F).

% -------------------------------------------------
% Exactly one colour for each output position
1 { output(Rout,Cout,Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- rect_cell(Rout,Cout).

% Exactly one filler colour (the smallest admissible one)
1 { filler(F) : color(F) } 1 :- filler(F).
